long_term_milestone.title: Planner-Gated Generalized Fetch-To-Pose v1
long_term_milestone.body: Deliver a no-shoot, robot-owned fetch behavior where the planner chooses the bounded route, Nav2 or recovery setup owns approach geometry where it has evidence, local fetch closes the line, and a bounded contact servo finishes only inside a measured delivery envelope.

architecture_direction.label: LLM / world-state planner routes
architecture_direction.body: Classify each scene as fetch_ready_local, nav2_reposition_first, scan_or_perceive_first, recovery_or_reaim, or ambiguous_or_unsafe_no_go before local fetch is judged.

architecture_direction.label: Nav2 / recovery / local fetch setup
architecture_direction.body: Use Nav2 and recovery setup to reach a forward-only contact-ready pose, then use local fetch only when the ball-target line, standoff, lateral error, yaw, and freshness gates are inside bounds.

architecture_direction.label: Bounded contact servo
architecture_direction.body: Advance into contact with limited forward authority, monitor ball motion and delivery radius, and report contact-quality watches separately from delivery success.

architecture_direction.label: Evidence monitor
architecture_direction.body: Keep geometry, model provenance, browser-safe videos, keyframe sheets, first-contact quality, and promotion_evidence status visible in every evidence package.

evidence_ladder.label: Artifact floor
evidence_ladder.body: geometry_consistency.pass, calibrated_golf_ball provenance, golf_ball_delivery_zone_marker, and same-session onboard plus context video.

evidence_ladder.label: Planner handoff gate
evidence_ladder.body: Mixed scenes must route correctly with zero wrong fetch dispatches before executable local-fetch outcomes count.

evidence_ladder.label: Route-owner visual UAT
evidence_ladder.body: Executable fetch_ready_local, nav2_reposition_first, and recovery_or_reaim routes need browser-watchable delivery packages; planner-only scan/defer and no-go routes need browser-watchable stopped-scene proof with local fetch withheld.

evidence_ladder.label: Broad randomized route-owner batches
evidence_ladder.body: Seeded route-quality batches measure breadth and surface setup/contact watches while keeping promotion_evidence false.

evidence_ladder.label: Canonical promotion ladder
evidence_ladder.body: Saved-layout repeatability and seeded-random promotion gates remain the milestone proof after route-owner quality stabilizes.
